## What this notebook checks

Define exactly how day type, exercise, and sleep are coded and confirm that the
analysed exposure outcome matches the approved definition. Account for
repeated measurements and similarity between measurements close in time.
Whenever an interaction---a test of whether an association differs across
groups---is included, retain the corresponding individual terms. Define the
groups of \(p\)-values adjusted together for the H06 site comparisons before
inspecting results.

## What this notebook uses and produces

- Uses: the prepared H06 dataset in `artifacts/06_model_data/H06.rds`.
- Produces: definitions of the day type, exercise, and sleep variables; fitted
  models; raw and adjusted tests; model checks; effect estimates in
  interpretable units with 95% confidence intervals; the exact participants,
  participant-days, hourly observations, and sites used by each model; counts
  for every day-type and exercise category overall and by site; the usable
  sleep observations in each fitted sleep model; tables; figures; and source
  data.
- Data sensitivity: fit this identical H06 implementation to the
  manuscript-prepared dataset and compare exact samples, category counts,
  estimates, 95% confidence intervals, diagnostics, and conclusions.
